subject: gk
question:
Read the following statements carefully and choose the **correct **option regarding Assertion (A) and Reason (R).

**Assertion (A)**: WTO encourages free and fair trade across nations.

**Reason (R)**: It allows countries to impose arbitrary restrictions to protect domestic industries.

options.text: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A.
A is true but R is false.
A is false but R is true.

solution:
The correct answer is **A is true but R is false.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Assertion (A): TRUE**

 
 
• **World Trade Organization** promotes **free and fair trade**
 
• Reduces **trade barriers (tariffs, quotas)**
 
• Follows **rules-based system**
 
• Ensures **non-discrimination (MFN principle)**
 
 

 
• **Reason (R): FALSE**

 
 
• WTO **does not allow arbitrary restrictions**
 
• Restrictions allowed only under **specific conditions**
 
• Must be **justified and regulated**
 
• Arbitrary protection = **against WTO rules**
